comment: This workspace has autoInstallPeers on, and several Expo/RN packages are reached only
through unpinned peer deps. pnpm then resolves them on its own, and a wrong pick is
invisible until the app dies at launch — see apps/mobile/package.json, where
@expo/metro-runtime had to be pinned because it had resolved to 4.0.1 (an old major)
while Expo SDK 57 requires ^57.0.11. That one is the fix for a real launch crash;
the override below is defence-in-depth against the same class of problem.
unpinned peer, which resolved to 0.87.0 and pulled a second Metro (0.87) plus its 0.87
polyfills into a 0.86 workspace. The polyfills are injected at the top of every bundle,
so pinning them keeps the prelude on one version. Re-check on every SDK bump.
